paragraphs.text: Appends a tiny ice marker to the end of every sentence the model writes, chain of thought included.
# 🧊 dsh-ice-probe
A tiny DeepSeek Harness plugin that appends a 🧊 marker to the end of **every sentence** the model wr
ites — including its **chain of thought** — and plays a short sound for each insertion.
It is a mechanical output-pipeline transform, **not** a prompt. The model is never asked to add emoj
i, so it cannot forget, miscount, or imitate.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

[代码示例省略，未执行]
…and you hear a small blip each time a 🧊 lands on the screen.
## Features
- **Sentence-end ice for text *and* reasoning.** Implemented on the host `llm/stream` waterfall, so

it works for every model call.
- **Survives settling.** The settled copy of a finished step is trans

formed too, so the ice does not disappear when reasoning collapses.
- **Sound for every insertion.**
A short synthesized tone; no audio assets, no downloads. Queue length selects one of four tiers, an

d a tier drains that many ice markers from the queue.
- **Idempotent.** Text that already has ice in

front of its punctuation is left alone.
- **Safe.** Code fences, inline code, numbers (`2.5`), file
names (`core.js`), abbreviations (`e.g.`), tool-call arguments, session titles, compaction summaries

and sub-agent/workflow sessions are never touched.
- **No configuration required.** Enable it: it a
pplies. Disable it: the module is unloaded.

the on/off switch — there is no in-conversation toggle.

## Verify it works
The host half serves two local routes under your DSH web server:
| Route | Purpose |

| `/ice-probe/` | Live counters, the last few rewrites (`samples`), skip counters, last error |
| `/
ice-probe/selftest` | The built-in sentence-transform test suite (also `npm run selftest`) |
`/ice-probe/` returning 404 means the plugin is not mounted (disabled in the marketplace, or not ins
obe/` returning 404 means the plugin is not mounted (disabled in the marketplace, or not installed).
## Behavior and limits
- **Ice goes before the punctuation**, so the sentence stays grammatical and copy/paste keeps normal

punctuation at the end.
- **Chinese:** `。 ！ ？ …` always get ice.
- **English:** `! ?` always get ic
e (a run such as `!!!` counts once). A period only gets ice when it is followed by whitespace, a new

line, or the end of the text — so decimals, versions, filenames and abbreviations are left alone.
-
**Never iced:** fenced/inline code, tool-call arguments, session titles, compaction summaries, sub-a

gent and workflow output.
- **The ice is written into the conversation log.** It is part of the assi
stant message from then on; turning the plugin off does not remove ice from old messages, and the ex

tra characters count toward the context.
- **Sound requires a user gesture** (browser autoplay polic
y). The first click/keypress on the page unlocks audio; until then ice is counted silently and plays
lick/keypress on the page unlocks audio; until then ice is counted silently and plays once unlocked.
## Privacy

- Everything runs locally: a host transform and a client-side counter.
- No telemetry, no network ca

lls, no data collection. The two routes above are served by your own DSH web server.
- The plugin on
ly ever *adds* characters to model output; it never rewrites existing text away.
